results.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
results.overview: January 29, 2024. Red Crescent volunteers receive an emergency call. A five-year old girl is trapped in a car under fire in Gaza, pleading for rescue. While trying to keep her on the line, they do everything they can to get an ambulance to her. Her name was Hind Rajab.

results.title: Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke
results.overview: When the snobbish and wealthy AlThahabi family find out they're actually not as loaded as they think, they're forced to fake their affluence to survive.

results.title: Eagles of the Republic
results.overview: George Fahmy, Egypt's most adored actor, is pressured to star in a film commissioned by the highest authorities. He reluctantly accepts and finds himself thrown into the inner circle of power. Like moth drawn to flame, he begins an affair with the mysterious wife of the general overseeing the project.

results.title: Capernaum
results.overview: After running away from his negligent parents, committing a violent crime and being sentenced to five years in jail, a hardened, streetwise 12-year-old Lebanese boy sues his parents in protest of the life they have given him.

results.title: Saqr and Kanarya
results.overview: Saqr, a legendary mercenary decides to leave his dangerous double life behind and start fresh. But an unexpected encounter with Bilal, a failed writer obsessed with the world of espionage, turns his plans upside down. The unlikely duo find themselves thrown into a thrilling yet hilarious ride that changes everything - unlike anything they’ve ever known.

results.title: All That's Left of You
results.overview: After a Palestinian teen gets swept up into a West Bank protest, his mother recounts the family story of hope, courage and relentless struggle that led to this fateful moment.

results.title: Love in Slow Motion
results.overview: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?

results.title: The Ambush
results.overview: It is the winter of 2018, the men and women of the UAE military are deployed to provide aid. At the Mocha Base, spirits are high as three Emirati soldiers anticipate an imminent return home. While on their final routine patrol, the three soldiers, Ali, Bilal and Hindasi are ambushed by heavily armed militants on their route, through a narrow canyon. Trapped, wounded, and out of communication range, the three soldiers realize the gravity of their situation. They are running out of options, munitions - and time. Back at the base, their commander receives word and realizes that the assault on the UAE army patrol was premeditated. A rescue mission is quickly put into action, but will air and land support reach the men in time, and will they survive?

results.title: The Blue Caftan
results.overview: A middle-aged tailor and his wife find their relationship challenged by the arrival of a handsome new apprentice.

results.title: 7 Dogs
results.overview: Interpol agent Khalid Al-Azzazi joins forces with Ghali Abu Dawood from the 7 Dogs crime syndicate to fight drug trafficking.

results.title: EgyBest
results.overview: Two friends dive into the digital underworld chasing quick cash and bigger dreams. Their journey begins with a scam, but soon. The stakes turn deadly. Pulled into a web of love lies, and crime. they risk everything for success, in this high stakes game, one wrong move could change everything.

results.title: Majda
results.overview: Majda is a musician and a zither instructor, who has been living a happy and quiet life with her husband, who runs a restaurant. However, the winds of treachery and infidelity threaten to blow her quiet home when an old lover appears.

results.title: From the Ashes
results.overview: At a strict girls school, a mysterious fire blazes out of control. Now everyone's questioning whether it was an accident — or arson.

results.title: The Message
results.overview: In sixth-century Mecca, Prophet Muhammad receives his first revelation from God as a messenger. Three years later, he's not alone in his quest and publicly declares his prophecy. Muhammad is fought by Abu Sufian and his wife Hind, rulers of Mecca. Muhammad's followers are hunted and tortured but he continues his calling.

results.title: The Secret of the Orchard
results.overview: The film tells the story of “Al-Sayyid Ibrahim” (Mohamed Benbrahim), a successful businessman who owns a farm with every sign of wealth. He has a son studying abroad and another son named “Ahmed” (Youssef Al-Jundi) who will run the farm.

results.title: No Other Land
results.overview: This film made by a Palestinian-Israeli collective shows the destruction of the occupied West Bank's Masafer Yatta by Israeli soldiers and the alliance which develops between the Palestinian activist Basel and Israeli journalist Yuval.

results.title: The Shore Waves
results.overview: Hemaida is a young man who leaves his mother to travel to the city of Casablanca, where his friend Al Arabi is going to help him find a job and provide him with accommodation. However, he faces many problems while he is there when he discovers that his friend works in drug trafficking.
